records.title: Elijah at Horeb
records.status: reviewed local; uploaded to R2 staging only; not activated
records.description: Elijah lowers his mantle and lifts his gaze at the cave entrance. This selective illustration concerns 1 Kings 19:11-13, not a visible portrayal of God or the call of Elisha.
records.posterAlt: Elijah holds his rough mantle at the cave entrance in dawn light. An imagined scene.
records.visualReview: Full-size two-second frame and 1fps contact sheet retain the approved angular weathered brown face, prominent nose, gray-black natural curls and full beard, lean sturdy build and rough mantle. He lowers the mantle during the scene; the description does not claim his face remains covered. Fingers, hand, arm and cloth remain coherent in the inspected frames. Natural blue-lavender dawn and stone are retained. No visible divine figure or definite identity break observed.

records.title: Naboth's Vineyard
records.status: reviewed local; uploaded to R2 staging only; not activated
records.description: Elijah lowers his hand while Ahab looks down in the vineyard. This illustrates the confrontation in 1 Kings 21:17-20; Naboth, Jezebel and the killing are not shown.
records.posterAlt: Elijah confronts Ahab among the grapevines. An imagined scene.
records.visualReview: Full-size two-second frame and 1fps sheet preserve distinct Elijah and Ahab faces, natural hair, body builds and clothing. Elijah retains angular weathered brown face, graying curls and beard and rough mantle. Ahab retains the broad brown face, circlet and burgundy cloth; gray is subtle in the lower beard and temple hair, and must be compared again against the active later Ahab/Micaiah v2 before final batch activation. Visible hands and limbs remain coherent. No violence or new people shown.
